contexts.text: As soon as the interior bodily things grow cold, the vital substances are separated from the man. Described. So that nothing vital can remain.
They who are in hatred, perceive... a something vital in it.
The good of love is the vital fire itself.
All the vital motions depend on this.
Love is the origin of the vital heat. CL 380:12. ISB 6:2.
Pale = what is not vital; (and this), in the Word, exists with those who are not in goods of life from truths of doctrine.
For the Vital of the husband adds itself to the Vital of the wife...
